en.html:
Chachamaru was wounded.
Not lightly. 'Seriously wounded' also was not quite the right description.

How deep. How wide. How much blood had gone.
The part of my brain that was still clear considered all of it and gave the answer.

Fatal.

Even a warrior's healing could not stop her life leaving through that wound.

ja.html:
茶々丸は負傷している。
　軽傷ではない。重傷という表現も厳密には当てはま
らない。

　傷の深さ、大きさ、出血の量……
　それらを勘案して、脳の醒めた部分が告げている。

　これは致命傷だ。

　武者の回復力をもってしても生命の流出を留められ
ない、傷。

A small, shining sphere was falling.
Straight down from the highest point of the sky. Toward the silver armor.
